newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHISPANK GROUP 97 Q1 PROFIT 27 MLN EEK.
newsitem.headline: UHISPANK GROUP 97 Q1 PROFIT 27 MLN EEK.

text.p: Uhispank the second largest pank in Estonia said on Wednesday that their group profit for first quarter 1997 was 27 million kroons vs 1996 whole year result of 57.5 million kroons.
In a statement the bank said that their total operating income was for the first quarter was 81.6 million kroons vs 254.4 million kroons for 1996.
The bank's total administrative costs for the first quarter 1997 was 44.4 million kroons compared to 151.7 million kroons for all of 1996.
Personnel costs was 23.7 million kroons until the end of April 1997 against 82 million kroons for 1996.
Income received from fees and commissions in first quarter was 21.5 million kroons compared to 1996's 52.3 million kroons.
Income from financial trading was 7.8 million kroons against 1996's 21 million kroons, while income from securities was 10.6 million kroons versus 1996's 24.1 million kroons.
